import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pos {
        int r, c;
        Pos(int _r, int _c) { r = _r; c = _c; }
    }

    static int N, T, W;
    static char[][] B;
    static int[] D1, D2;
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> G;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int t, int r, int c) { to = t; rev = r; cap = c; }
    }

    static int ID(int r, int c) { return r * W + c; }

    static void bfs_z(Pos src) {
        D1 = new int[W * W];
        Arrays.fill(D1, -1);
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        D1[ID(src.r, src.c)] = 0;
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos u = q.poll();
            int ui = ID(u.r, u.c);
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = u.r + dr[k];
                int nc = u.c + dc[k];
            if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
            int ni = ID(nr, nc);
            if (D1[ni] != -1) continue;
            D1[ni] = D1[ui] + 1;
            q.add(new Pos(nr, nc);
            }
        }
    }
    }

    static void bfs_one(Pos src) {
        D2 = new int[W * W];
        Arrays.fill(D2, -1);
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        D2[ID(src.r, src.c)] = 0;
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos u = q.poll();
            int ui = ID(u.r, u.c);
            if (D1[ui] >= 0 && D2[ui] >= D1[ui]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = u.r + dr[k];
                int nc = u.c + dc[k];
            if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
            int ni = ID(nr, nc);
            if (D2[ni] != -1) continue;
            if (D1[ni] >= 0 && D1[ni] < D2[ui] + 1) continue;
            D2[ni] = D2[ui] + 1;
            q.add(new Pos(nr, nc));
        }
    }
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        Edge a = new Edge(v, G[v].size(), c);
        Edge b = new Edge(u, G[u].size(), 0);
        G[u].add(a);
        G[v].add(b);
    }

    static int dinic(int s, int t) {
        final int INF = 1000000000;
        int ans = 0;
        while (true) {
            int[] level = new int[G.size()];
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : G.get(v)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        if (level[t] == -1) break;
        int[] it = new int[G.size()];
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs(s, INF, t, G, level, it)) > 0) {
            ans += pushed;
        }
    }
    return ans;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int f, int t, ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> G, int[] level, int[] it) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (; it[v] < G.get(v).size(); it[v]++) {
            Edge e = G.get(v).get(it[v]);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[v] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap), t, G, level, it);
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    G.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        W = N + 2;
        B = new char[W][W];
        for (int i = 0; i < W; i++) {
            B[i] = new char[W];
            for (int j = 0; j < W; j++) B[i][j] = '#';
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String row = sc.next();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                B[r][c] = row.charAt(c - 1);
            }
        }
        char[][] B1 = new char[W][W];
        for (int i = 0; i < W; i++) {
            B1[i] = new char[W];
            for (int j = 0; j < W; j++) B1[i][j] = B[i][j];
        }
        char[][] B2 = new char[W][W];
        for (int i = 0; i < W; i++) {
            B2[i] = new char[W];
            for (int j = 0; j < W; j++) B2[i][j] = '#';
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String row = sc.next();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                B2[r][c] = row.charAt(c - 1);
            }
        }
        ArrayList<Pos> sci = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Pos> caps = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = null;
        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                char ch = B[r][c];
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    if (ch > '0') sci.add(new Pos(r, c));
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    z = new Pos(r, c);
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
                char ch2 = B2[r][c];
                if (ch2 >= '0' && ch2 <= '9' && ch2 > '0')
                    caps.add(new Pos(r, c));
            }
        }
        bfs_z(z);
        int nS = sci.size();
        int nC = caps.size();
        int SRC = 0;
        int SINK = nS + nC + 1;
        int V = SINK + 1;
        G = new ArrayList<>(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        final int INF = 98765432;
        for (int i = 0; i < nS; i++) {
            Pos s = sci.get(i);
            add_edge(SRC, i + 1, B1[s.r][s.c] - '0');
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < nC; j++) {
            Pos c = caps.get(j);
            add_edge(nS + j + 1, SINK, B2[c.r][c.c] - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < nS; i++) {
            Pos s = sci.get(i);
            bfs_one(s);
            for (int j = 0; j < nC; j++) {
                Pos c = caps.get(j);
                int ci = ID(c.r, c.c);
                if (D2[ci] >= 0 && D2[ci] <= T)
                    add_edge(i + 1, nS + j + 1, INF);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic(SRC, SINK));
    }
}
